newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indocement active on restructuring talk.
newsitem.headline: Indocement active on restructuring talk.

text.p: Shares price of Indonesian cement maker PT Indocement rose 3.43 percent in Monday's morning session on market talk that it would divest its stake in sister firm PT Indofood, brokers and analysts said.
It was up 150 rupiah to 4,525 rupiah on active turnover of about 3.7 million shares.
"I think the active buying in Indocement was linked to rumours in the market the Indocement will restructure the company soon," an analyst a with European securities firm said.
Another analyst with Vickers Ballas Tamara said there was market talk that the company was likely to divest its stake in sister firm PT Indofood Sukses Makmur, Indonesia's largest noodle maker.
There was no immediate comment from the companies.
"It's unclear how they are going to divest the stake," the Vickers's analyst said.
He added that one rumoured scenario was that Indocement's shareholders would get bonus shares in Indofood, but the ratio and price were still unclear.
Both analysts said the move would affect Indocement' valuation as Indofood's current contribution to Indocement earnings was significant.
Indocement is a majority stake of just over 50 percent in Indofood.
Last Thursday, Indofood Sukses Makmur was cross-traded on the Surabaya Stock Exchange at a large volume of 104.1 million shares with a total value of 541.8 billion rupiah.
At the lunchbreak on Monday, Indocement was up 100 rupiah to 4,475 rupiah on a volume of about four million shares, while Indofood was up 100 rupiah to 5,550 rupiah on 44,000 shares.
